subject: Post-demo: model eval intake & capture of sensitive/edge-case prompts
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Menon <asha@pulseai.com>, Samir Gupta <samir@pulseai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: model eval intake & capture of sensitive/edge-case prompts

Hi Asha / Samir — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and explicit asks so we can move to an initial eval baseline this week.

Recap (30-min demo):
- Showed inference latency/cost tradeoffs for retrieval-augmented generation and direct generation.
- Walked through Redwood Console trace and token-level cost breakdown.
- Discussed the importance of catching correctness regressions on your long-tail queries and handling PII redaction in outputs.

Recommended starting models for evaluation (based on your latency and throughput targets):
- rw-llama-7B-int8 (fast, lower-cost baseline for real-time agent flows)
- rw-llama-33B-q4f16 (higher quality for longer-form summarization and legal-style answers)
- Fallback recommendation: rw-llama-13B-ptq for mixed workloads

Benchmarks and reference: https://docs.redwood.ai/benchmarks/inference-profiles (see LLM quality/latency table in the comma-separated sheet)

Concrete asks (what we need from DataPulse):
1) Prompt set: 500–1,000 representative prompts including the common user intents and expected system role instructions. Prioritize queries you consider high-risk for hallucination (e.g., fact-checking, medical claims).
2) Edge-case examples: 50–100 prompts that often lead to off-nominal behavior (contradictions, long context, PII in user prompt). Please label each example with: source (web/app), expected output, and why it’s an edge case.
3) Redaction guidance: a short doc or a few examples showing how you currently redact or flag PII (e.g., patient IDs, full SSNs, account numbers). If you have an internal policy, attach it; otherwise a few sample redacted strings are fine.

Upload options: Drive folder (preferred) — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPromptIntake — or if you prefer S3 we can provide temporary credentials. See attached demo deck for context (redwood-demo-deck.pdf).

Next steps / timeline we propose:
- You share prompts + redaction examples by Fri 3/18.
- Redwood: initial baseline eval on 1k subset by Tue 3/21 (Marissa will run).
- Quick sync Wed 3/22 to review baseline results.

Notes on privacy: we can ingest redacted data into a private S3 bucket linked to Redwood Private if you need air-gapped handling. Otherwise Drive uploads are fine for initial analysis.

Let me know if the timeline is tight — we can shift.

Thanks,
Marcus
Sr. Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0139

Attachment: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (PDF)
From: Asha Menon <asha@pulseai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir@pulseai.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 17:20:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: model eval intake & capture of sensitive/edge-case prompts

Thanks Marcus — great session.

We can assemble the prompts but wanted to call out a couple items before we upload:
- A large portion of our queries contain protected health information (PHI) and customer identifiers. We will provide redacted examples but also need to agree on a conservative redaction policy for the seed set.
- For edge cases, we have examples where users paste entire medical notes and the expected behavior is to summarize without leaking identifiers.

Attached a single redacted example to show format (sensitive-example-redacted.txt). We'll aim to upload a Drive folder by Fri 3/18 but might use S3 for the unredacted originals and provide a hashed mapping if needed.

Quick question: what level of redaction do you prefer for the initial baseline? Replace PII with placeholders (e.g., [PATIENT_ID]) or fully remove?

—Asha
Principal Product Manager | DataPulse
asha@pulseai.com | +1 617-555-0202

Attachment: sensitive-example-redacted.txt (text)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Asha Menon <asha@pulseai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: model eval intake & capture of sensitive/edge-case prompts

Thanks Asha — good questions. A few practical suggestions from the eval team: 

Eval plan (short):
- Sample size: run on 1k prompts initially (stratified by intent buckets).
- Metrics: exact-match where appropriate, ROUGE/L, and a simple hallucination score (binary label by raters on whether answer introduces unverifiable facts). Also track token cost / latency.
- Redaction handling for baseline: please use placeholders for any strong identifiers (e.g., [PATIENT_ID], [SSN_LAST4], [ACCOUNT_NUM]). That preserves context for evaluation while protecting raw identifiers.

Prompt/metadata schema (recommended CSV columns): id, prompt_text, expected_output, intent_tag, severity (low/medium/high), contains_pii (yes/no), pii_type (if yes), notes. I've attached a template: prompt-intake-template.csv.

Model recommendations for the initial run:
- rw-llama-7B-int8 (baseline)
- rw-llama-13B-ptq (mid)
- rw-llama-33B-q4f16 (high-quality)

Ben — can you own S3 ingestion and grant a temp presigned URL for uploading the original files if DataPulse prefers that method? If we do S3, we will ingest to a bucket tagged DP-2028-0314-01 and apply a redaction-first import.

Asha — once you upload, let us know the Drive/S3 link. We’ll triage and run the 1k baseline within 48 hours of ingest.

Marissa
Lead, Eval & Model Fit | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Attachment: prompt-intake-template.csv (CSV)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Menon <asha@pulseai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: model eval intake & capture of sensitive/edge-case prompts

Perfect, thank you all. Finalizing next steps and owners:

Action items:
- Asha/DataPulse: upload prompt CSV + edge-case folder to Drive or S3 by EOD Mon 3/18 (owner: Asha). If using S3, send presigned link to ben@redwood.ai.
- Ben: provision ingestion S3 bucket (DP-2028-0314-01) + presigned URL and confirm minimal retention TTL. Deliverable: presigned URL by EOD Mon 3/17.
- Marissa: run 1k stratified baseline across the three model variants and produce a short slide deck with quality/cost/latency tradeoffs. Target: Tue 3/21.
- Marcus: schedule Wed 3/22 sync to walk results and prioritize follow-ups.

Asha — on the redaction question, we’ll accept placeholders (recommended) for the baseline. If you need us to also run with fully removed fields, note that it may reduce context for some prompts — we can run both if you can provide both versions.

Please also include a short prioritized list of the top 10 edge-case prompts that you most want to see improved or protected. That will help us focus human raters during the evaluation.

Thanks again — looking forward to the uploads.

Marcus
Sr. Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0139
